correctness.rationale: For n>=3 and k>=1, with m=3k+1, every layer of C_n ⊗_f C_m needs at least k dominators since k-1 internally covers at most 3k-3 and external connecting edges at most two. Equality kn forces exactly one internal hole and a unique tiling by k disjoint triple neighborhoods in each layer; each of the n connecting edges must cover exactly one distinct hole, forcing a coherent cyclic orientation and f(i+2)-f(i) in S_k={2,5,...,3k-1} modulo m. The i↦i+2 orbit lengths are n (odd n) or n/2 (even n). Zero-sum closed walks exist at all even lengths, at odd >=5 for k>=3, odd >=7 for k=2, and only even for k=1; 3-step and (k=2) 5-step sums are impossible. A periodic four-pattern map and one extra selected hole produce kn+1 universally. This yields all exceptional n. Independently tested modular walks and direct graph domination for 304 pairs 3<=n<=40,1<=k<=8; the infinite reasoning is the layer/step equivalence, not finite DP.
residual_risks: The result minimizes over connecting maps; no formula for each prescribed f. Internal unique-hole proof requires exactly one uncovered per layer at equality.
